S.5, Special Branch. Shh/drl
REPORT
Date September 4, 1939.
Subject A. H. Buchman
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder

A.H. Buchman, American, publisher and proprietor of the "Erh Tung Jih Pao" (兒童日報) and the "Living Age" (動向), the first being published in Chinese and the latter in both Chinese and English, left Shanghai for Manila by the s.s. President Pierce on Saturday, September 2nd.

The management of the American President line, when approached by Buchman for a third class passage to Manila, tried to dissuade the youth, as the third class accommodation on vessels as the "Pierce" is not such as to increase the dignity of the Whites forced to travel in such manner.

Subject has not booked a return passage, nor does any of the staff of his two publications know when, if at all, he will return.

The certificates for the "Erh Tung Jih Pao" and the "Living Age," being in the name of Chiang Jui-chin (張瑞清), no action has been taken to stop their publication.

Careful note is being made of the activities of both papers in view of the recent receipt by Buchman of a threatening letter from a quarter opposed to Chungking by which government Buchman's publications are subsidized.

E. M. Golder
D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

事由：A. H. Buchman
由副督察长戈尔德（Golder）制作并转呈

美国人A.H. Buchman，《儿童日报》（Erh Tung Jih Pao）和《动向》（Living Age）的出版人及业主，前者为中文刊物，后者为中英文双语刊物，已于9月2日星期六乘“皮尔斯总统号”轮船离开上海前往马尼拉。

当Buchman向美商轮船公司预订前往马尼拉的三等舱位时，该公司曾试图劝阻这位年轻人，因为像“皮尔斯号”这样的船只上的三等舱设施，并不足以维持被迫以此方式旅行的白人的尊严。

当事人未预订回程船票，其两家出版物的员工均不知他何时（如果还会的话）返回。

由于《儿童日报》和《动向》的登记证均以张瑞清（Chiang Jui-chin）的名义持有，故未采取行动停止其出版。

鉴于Buchman最近收到一封来自反对重庆政府方面的威胁信，而Buchman的出版物正受该政府补贴，警方正密切关注这两份报刊的活动。

E. M. Golder

Dear Mr. Golder:

To put the matter straight about the various
publications, the following:

1. NRH TUNG JIH PAO, a daily newspaper for children, was
registered with you (by Mr. McKeown) in February or
March, 1939. On July 1, publication was suspended for
Summer holidays. About three weeks ago you requested
Mr. Huang Yih-teh, the Editor, to return the registra-
tion certificate, which was done. A new registration
certificate has not been issued.

Resumption of publication of the NRH TUNG JIH PAO is
scheduled on August 21. I shall call on you shortly
for a form to be submitted for reregistration of this
publication.

2. THE WU PAO. Some months ago I made an application for
registration of a new Chinese daily paper to be known
as the WU PAO. (This paper formerly published as the
TOOCHOW KUNG PAO.). The application for registration
of the WU PAO I hereby request to be cancelled, since
the WU PAO will not appear. No certificate of registra-
tion for the WU PAO was issued by you, to the best of
my knowledge.

A third publication mentioned by you over the phone (I do
not recall the name) has nothing to do with the Alexander
Publishing and Printing Company, the periodicals of which
consist at present only of the NRH TUNG JIH PAO and THE
LIVING AGE (SHENG SHIH), the latter being a new bi-lingual
monthly, the first issue of which has just appeared.

Very truly yours,
Alexander H. Buchman

为了澄清有关各种出版物的事宜，具体如下：

1. 《NRH TUNG JIH PAO》，一份儿童日报，曾于1939年2月或3月向贵处注册（由McKeown先生经办）。7月1日，因暑假暂停出版。约三周前，贵处要求该报编辑黄以德（Huang Yih-teh）先生退回登记证，已照办。新的登记证尚未签发。

《NRH TUNG JIH PAO》定于8月21日复刊。我将不久后拜访贵处，索取表格以重新注册该出版物。

贵处在电话中提到的第三份出版物（我不记得名称了）与亚历山大出版印刷公司无关，该公司目前的期刊仅包括《NRH TUNG JIH PAO》和《生活时代》（THE LIVING AGE，即《盛世》SHENG SHIH），后者是一份新的双语月刊，首期刚刚出版。

此致

Alexander H. Buchman
